errors.evidence: The description incorrectly maps the value 20% to the category 'Неизправност'. The bar for 'Неизправност' (the third from the left) corresponds to the value 20%, but the category label under this bar is 'Прекъсване на конкуренцията / пазара', not 'Неизправност'. The bar for 'Неизправност' (fourth from the left) has a value of approximately 19%.
The description states that the value for the category 'Етично нарушение' is 10%, but the corresponding bar in the chart is visibly below the 10% grid line, at approximately 9%.
